model_error: The leaf checker could not start. Reload the app while online once.
setup_phone_hint: Stored only on this phone. Never sent anywhere.
capture_guide: Turn the leaf over. Photograph the LOWER side of one leaf, lying sideways on white paper, filling most of the photo.
q_blurry: The photo is blurry. Hold the phone still and try again.
q_dark: The photo is too dark. Move to better light.
q_bright: The photo is too bright. Move out of direct sun.
q_no_leaf: No leaf found. Put one leaf on white paper so it fills the photo.
q_failed_note: This photo will not be used.
q_block: Which block are these leaves from?
q_sprayed: Has anyone sprayed this block in the last month?
causes: Likely causes of the yield drop
heatmap_caption: The coloured area is what the tool looked at.
no_phone: Add a basic phone number in Settings to send the SMS.
context_age: Weather and soil data built {days} days ago (coarse estimates, not measured on this plot).
check_saved: Saved to history and queued for sync.
sync_explain: This is exactly what will be sent. No name, no phone number, no photo, no location from this phone.
sync_failed: Could not send. The reports stay queued and you can try again later.
sync_offline: You are offline. Connect to the internet to send.
show_latency: Show inference time on the result
demo_mode: Demo mode: add an earlier Block B check (labelled demo data)
demo_added: Demo check added for Block B.
clear_data: Clear all data on this phone
clear_confirm: Delete all checks, queued reports and settings on this phone?
cleared: All data on this phone was deleted.
review_note: Kiswahili text and audio are machine-drafted and need native speaker review. Guidance is a draft, not reviewed by an agronomist.
